companyDescription: Your trusted partner for all type insurance policy management. Secure, reliable, and user-friendly platform for all your policy needs.
footerTagline: Every policy tracked by you. Every due date remembered. Every day.
youReOfflineCheck: You're offline — check your internet connection.
getDueDateReminders: Get due-date reminders and updates in your Windows or phone notification panel, even when this tab is closed. This applies to this device only.
wantA60SecondTour: Want a 60-second tour of where everything lives on your dashboard? You can skip any time.
leaveYourNumber: Leave your number and the reason — our team will call you back. We don't share a direct number.
weReOutsideCallHours: We're outside call hours right now
callsArePlacedOnly: — calls are placed only in business hours (IST)
brieflyTellUsWhat: Briefly tell us what you need help with…
doubleCheckTheNumber: Double-check the number — it's the only way we can reach you. A wrong number means a missed call.
tourAddAPolicyBody: Start here to create a new policy record — holder details, nominee, bank info, and policy terms all in one form.
tourViewAllYourBody: Browse, search, and edit every record you've added. This is your main working list.
tourTrackThisMonthBody: See every policy with a payment due this month, along with mode of payment and last payment date.
tourCatchMissedPaymentsBody: Policies that missed last month's payment show up here — act before a lapse notice goes out.
tourPlanAheadForBody: This card shows what's coming due next month, so you can follow up with clients before it's urgent.
tourYourSubscriptionBody: Check your current plan, when it expires, and upgrade any time from here.
tourSwitchLanguageBody: Prefer a different language? Change it any time from here — it applies across the whole app.
tourReferralWalletBody: Refer other agents and earn commission here. Track your balance and use it to renew or upgrade your plan.
errorBody: An unexpected error occurred on {{site}}. Reloading the page usually fixes it.
enterAValid10Digit: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
somethingWentWrongPleaseTry: Something went wrong. Please try again, or email us.
pushUnsupported: This browser doesn't support device notifications. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
pushIosInstall: On iPhone/iPad, first add this app to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), open it from there, then come back here.
pushUnavailable: Device notifications aren't available right now. Please try again later.
pushDenied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then reload this page.
